name: meta-discipline-math
description: Advanced-mathematics discipline (17 skills): a rigor spine (proof rigor, quantitative sanity-checking, hypercomplex/geometric-algebra modeling), per-branch disciplines across calculus & analysis, linear algebra, probability & statistics, number theory, discrete math, differential equations, abstract algebra, complex analysis, and geometry & trigonometry, an empirical-statistics wing (experimental design, statistical inference, multivariate analysis), a scientific-validation discipline (design-to-inference review of data-driven claims, distilled into a typed claim graph), and a graph-drawing discipline (layout-convention choice, drawing pipelines, bounds, and mental-map-preserving animation) — each emitting a checkable ledger.
